notes.title: Demo Update - Release Notes for March 17th, 2023
notes.notes:
TLDR Patch Notes:
Full Controller Support for Dialogue and Settings
Added 2 new HUD options in the settings Menu
Spells free hand requirement has been fixed and added a "Can't Cast" error message.
Fixed loot not showing up in the inventory.
Global Food Rebalance. 

Known Issues: 
When starting a new game, you have to hit escape to access the inventory.

Next Patch:
Adding a tutorial to walk players through how to play the game.
Sprint Attacks: Each style will get a new attack that can be triggered by sprinting
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Detailed Demo Update Release Notes for March 17th, 2023:

- Added 2 New Stat Bar Displays for HUD. Select them in the Settings menu under Gameplay
- Tanthious HUD = The Default Emissive (glowy) HUD
- Basic HUD = Simple textured Health, Mana, Stamina and Food Bar
- Lowered Spawn Rate of Dragon Treasure Room
- Fixed Lich King Boss Music not looping
- Fixed Cathedral room, Destroy torch on pillars
- Increased Agro Range of Fallen Knight in Cathedral Room 
- Adjusted food amount for Berserker Mushrooms (-50%)
- Made AI Adjustments for Charge Demon. 
- Changed detection Range for Charge Demon. 
- Fixed Instant where Charge Demon was Reflecting Magic Missile
- Rebalanced Food, check the item descriptions for more details. 
- Added Save Preference to Show enemy Health Bars option in settings Double Check 
- Fixed Enemy Health bars not facing player 
- Fixed fighting style showing up in shops sell menu 
- Fixed a bug causing Inventory Items not showing up when looting
- Fix Blyss the Pissed Input for dialogue
- Fixed bug where Cursor would lock in inventory after talking to someone
- Reworked how Stat values are displayed on the HUD
- Dialogue now fully supports controllers
- Fixed Number of free Hands requirement not working on spells. 
- Fixed Music slider in Settings Menu. You can lower the music
- Lowered intro scene music 
- Controller Support for Settings Menu 
- Added B button / esc to back out of settings menu
- Navigation redone for settings menu.
- Global Cooldown now goes off during Invalid skills or spells instead of the full cooldown
- Added sword trails for skeletons, so players can better judge distance
- Fixed a LockInput bug after clicking continue after the you defeat the lich king
